items.prompt: Rationalise the denominator of \(\frac{5}{\sqrt{5}-1}\). Leave your answer in exact form.
items.scheme: M1 Multiply by conjugate. M1 Apply difference of squares. M1 Simplify denominator. A1 Exact result.

items.scheme: M1 Factorise numerator. M1 Factorise denominator. M1 Cancel common factor. A1 Original restrictions.

items.prompt: Solve \(2x^2-5x+3=0\) by factorisation, giving both roots.
items.scheme: M1 Split middle term. M1 Factorise into two linear factors. M1 One root. A1 Other root.

items.prompt: For \(f(x)=2x+1\) and \(g(x)=x^2-2\), find and simplify \(f(g(x))\) and \(g(f(x))\).
items.scheme: M1 Substitute g into f. M1 Simplify first composite. M1 Substitute f into g. A1 Simplify second composite.
